# Awnings & Signs Unlimited

> Family-owned awning, patio cover and signage manufacturer in Hawthorne, California,
> serving the South Bay and greater Los Angeles since 1982. Design, fabrication and
> installation all happen in-house; the owner is present on every measure and install.

## Business facts

- **Name:** Awnings & Signs Unlimited
- **Founded:** 1982 (second-generation, family-owned)
- **Experience:** Over 45 years

## Services

1. **Custom patio covers** — attached and freestanding aluminum covers, lattice pergolas and translucent panel roofs.
2. **Retractable awnings** — motorized and manual, over doors, decks and poolsides.
3. **Shade sails and structures** — tensioned canvas sails and slide-on-wire canopies for rooftop decks, dining terraces and pool areas.
4. **Commercial awnings** — retail and restaurant awnings with printed or applied graphics.
5. **Dimensional letters and signs** — channel and dimensional letters, building signage and monument signs, with permit drawings prepared as part of the job.
6. **Recovers and repairs** — recovering sound frames with new fabric; servicing previously installed awnings.

## Materials

- Welded aluminum and steel frames, fabricated in-house rather than assembled from bolted kits.
- Sunbrella marine-grade acrylic canvas.
- Translucent and insulated panel roofing.
- Frame gauge, fabric line and finish are named on the written quote before signing.

## Service area

Hawthorne, Torrance, El Segundo, Manhattan Beach, Hermosa Beach, Redondo Beach,
Palos Verdes, Gardena, Inglewood, Culver City, Marina del Rey, Playa del Rey,
Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, Long Beach and Los Angeles.

## How the process works

1. Customer calls or submits the quote form.
2. Free on-site measure; mounting conditions checked and frame/fabric options discussed.
3. Firm written quote with specifications named, plus drawings for permits, HOA or landlord approval.
4. Fabrication in the Hawthorne shop, then installation by the company's own insured crew with the owner present.

Typical timeline is three to five weeks from approved quote to installed product.

## Frequently asked questions

**What does a custom awning or patio cover cost?**
It depends on span, frame type and fabric. The measure is free and the quote is written.
Most prices are returned within two business days of the visit.

**How long does it take?**
Three to five weeks from approved quote to installed product. Fabrication happens in the
company's own Hawthorne shop, so there is no wait on an outside vendor.

**Do you handle permits, HOA and landlord approvals?**
Yes. Drawings and specifications are prepared for cities, HOAs and property managers.

**What fabrics and frames do you use?**
Welded aluminum and steel frames — not bolted kits — with Sunbrella marine-grade acrylic
canvas, vinyl, or polycarbonate panels depending on the application.

**Can you recover an existing awning?**
Usually. If the frame is sound it can be recovered with new fabric for a fraction of a
replacement cost.

**Do you do signs as well as awnings?**
Yes — dimensional and channel letters, building signage, monument signs, banners, window
graphics and awning lettering.

**Do you offer financing or payment plans?**
For more info, contact the sales team on (310) 438-6544.

**What is warrantied, and for how long?**
For more info, contact the sales team on (310) 438-6544.
